name: worklog-buddy
description: Pick a Jira ticket, then get nudged to post AI-written updates based on what you actually did in VS Code.

commands.title: Worklog: Start working on a ticket
Worklog: Set NVIDIA NIM API key

worklog.workThresholdMinutes.description: Active coding minutes before prompting 'what ticket are you on?' when none is selected.

worklog.updateReminderMinutes.description: Active coding minutes since the last update before nudging you to post a Jira update.

worklog.remindOnCommit.description: Nudge you to update Jira right after you make a git commit.

worklog.snoozeMinutes.description: How long to stay quiet after you snooze or dismiss a nudge.

worklog.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Gap of inactivity after which time stops counting toward active minutes.

worklog.autoNudge.description: Automatically nudge on commit / activity thresholds.

worklog.nim.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for NVIDIA NIM.

worklog.nim.model.description: Model to use for summary generation.

worklog.jira.email.description: Atlassian account email for API auth.
